title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Aisha Patel
body: Motivation: Production private deployments require automated, auditable rotation of TLS certificates and customer keys. This PR implements end-to-end automation for TLS cert rotation and KMS/HSM key integration across the Private Installer, Helm charts, and Terraform modules, with Vault/SealedSecrets support and migration/rollback tooling. Scope: - Add a new installer job and controller that can perform certificate rotation using either Vault-issued certs or customer-managed KMS/HSM backends. - Extend the private-installer Helm charts with values to opt into automated rotations, rotation windows, and fallback policies. - Add Terraform inputs/outputs for KMS/HSM configuration (AWS KMS keys, CloudHSM cluster refs, Vault mount paths) and migration helpers. - Introduce a migration job to sync existing sealed secrets into the new rotation-enabled secret format, plus a reversible rollback path. - Add integration tests and a CI smoke test that exercises rotation end-to-end against a test Vault instance and mock KMS backend. Summary of changes: - installer/rotation: new controller and CLI hook for scheduled rotations; supports Vault PKI, AWS KMS envelope encryption, and HSM signing via PKCS#11 proxy. - helm/private-installer: new values.yaml sections (rotation.enabled, rotation.provider, rotation.window, rotation.rollingUpdateStrategy) and template helpers for post-install hooks. - terraform/modules/kms: new module outputs for key_alias, hsm_cluster_id, vault_mount; updated examples for onprem and vpc installs. - tools/migrations: migration job that converts sealed-secrets to rotation-enabled secrets and records a reversible state for rollback. Rollout plan: 1) Deploy to internal canary (staging-private) with rotation.enabled=false to validate chart changes. 2) Run migration job in canary to validate secret translation. 3) Enable rotation in canary windows and monitor the rotation job. 4) Gradual rollout to customer private installs using config flag. Rollback plan: - The migration job writes a reversible marker and backing snapshot to the cluster's encrypt-server. The rollback path runs the reverse migration and reverts helm values. Security considerations: - Private Installer now supports Vault Transit PKI with mTLS to Vault. - HSM integration requires explicit enable flag and a PKCS#11 proxy; keys never leave HSM boundary. - Added RBAC rules scoped to rotation-controller service account. - Audit logs: every rotation step emits structured audit events that are forwarded to the cluster audit sink and optional Redwood Console ingestion. Testing: - Unit tests for controller logic and Helm template unit tests. - Integration smoke test uses a disposable Vault dev server and a stubbed KMS implementation that emulates envelope encryption and key rotation. - Load test to ensure rotation controller does not cause spikes in pod restarts during rolling updates. Backwards compatibility: - Default rotation.enabled=false; installs are opt-in. - Migration job is explicit and requires admin consent. Related: ENG-4211, ENG-4302, SUP-7895.

review_comments: Marco Liu: Request changes - controller logging needs correlation IDs for audit traces (addressed in a1b2c3d)

Sophie Tran: Question - how do we ensure zero-downtime rotation for long-lived connections? Reply: we add a rollingUpdateStrategy and preStop hook to gracefully drain connections; added documentation (installer/controllers/rotation/README.md)
Ben Carter: Approved after small nits - prefer shorter TTL default and explicit example for AWS KMS alias (fixed in terraform/modules/kms/README.md)
CI Bot: initial job failed - vault dev container flaked on startup; re-run and all checks passed
release_notes: Private Installer: Add opt-in automated TLS/KMS/HSM rotation with Vault and SealedSecrets support.
Helm: new rotation.enabled, rotation.provider, rotation.window values and post-install hooks.
Terraform: new KMS/HSM outputs and example configurations for on-prem installs.
Migration tooling: reversible conversion job for sealed secrets to rotation-enabled format.
